description: Graded accuracy of every published signal bias: hit rate by confidence, bias and symbol, Wilson intervals, Brier score, independent samples (free, cached 15 min, one full report per call — no pagination). Omit symbol for the all-symbols report; pass it to filter to one instrument. Check this before paying for get_signal_bias, to see whether its track record supports trusting the call. Returns 404 if nothing has been graded yet for that filter.
name: get_track_record
